AURA:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D game VFX sprite sheet, original organic golden transformation aura, TRANSPARENT background. Exactly 4 columns by 2 rows, 8 equal rectangular cells, perfectly aligned grid with absolutely NO visible grid lines or dividers. Each cell shows the same aura at the next phase of a seamless looping rising-energy animation. ONLY the energy effect, NO character, hair, body, pedestal, ground or scenery. A rounded flame-like sheath of turbulent luminous golden energy surrounding an EMPTY transparent center where a character will be drawn. Soft white-gold luminous filaments rise and curl upward, irregular soft tendrils, wispy flame tongues, airy translucent golden bloom, occasional soft amber ember, hand-drawn anime battle transformation VFX. Organic curved flowing contours, no angular zigzags, polygons, triangles, diamonds, circles, rings, wire outlines or straight geometric edges. Aura narrows softly toward its top and opens at the lower feet. Preserve a large clear center; do not obscure the character. High-quality detailed painted pixel-RPG effect with delicate light falloff and alpha edges. Each of 8 cells contains a COMPLETE isolated aura with generous transparent padding so neighboring frames never touch. All frames use identical position, size and center. Intended playback 12 fps with blended interpolation. Wide 2:1 sheet. No text, labels, letters, icons, watermark, black backdrop or checkerboard painted into the image.

EXPLOSÃO / PODERES:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original anime RPG 2D VFX animation sprite sheet on TRANSPARENT background. Exactly FOUR columns and TWO rows, EIGHT equal square cells, 4x2 grid, wide 2:1 aspect. An organic burst of golden-white energy that expands into flowing wind, smoke and light before dissolving. Eight consecutive animation frames: compact turbulent flare; blooming gust; expanded sweeping wisps; widest airy flowing burst; light dissipating; thinner drifting sparks; fading mist; almost vanished wisps. NO geometrical shapes, NO circles or concentric rings, no angular rays, no straight lines, no lightning zigzags, no polygons, no squares, no gems. Only irregular curved flowing flame-like energy and softly glowing dust, delicate luminous white-gold centers and amber tails. A hand-painted anime battle aura impact, compatible with detailed pixel RPG sprites. Absolutely no character, hair, ground, scene, labels, numbers, text, dividers or borders. Each cell contains the COMPLETE effect fully inside its own cell, leaving at least 15 percent transparent padding on EVERY side. Neighbors must not touch, leave transparent gutters. Genuine clean alpha transparency, no black, red, yellow or checkerboard background fill. Color exists only in the wisps, with soft alpha falloff into transparency. Uniform center and equal scale across all cells.
